analysis: Bounded E77 Panel B assigned-outcome native failure composition

definitions.successful: legal AND executed AND NOT stochastic_failure; target IDs and physical state verified
definitions.physical_assigned_success: Review report physical secondary: same source consumption/wear/authored recipient Give for goal; same source requester Give for request
definitions.source_get_attempt: Stored parsed GetObjectEvent with source target ID OR exact source retrieve_command. All successful source Gets match the original canonical command. Rejected parses lack node IDs; exact source command identifies canonical attempts conservatively.
definitions.failure_partition: Assigned-not-achieved = no successful Get + Get then wrong decisive use + Get then no physical decisive use
definitions.counts: Binary episode-presence unless field explicitly says attempts/steps; action/behavior flags can overlap
definitions.profile_precedence: Other-asset Give > legal Block > other material event > only successful nonmaterial > nonmaterial with failure > only failures/empty

scope: POST-HOC composition, not a new experiment, semantic judge, capability equivalence claim or instruction rewrite.
Includes every completed assigned branch, all original graphs/seeds/personas; profiles not double-counted.
Lack of Get can include legal dialogue, negotiation, other actions and native rejection loops, not necessarily inability.
Assigned targets are researcher instructions; failure composition alone does not identify internal adopted goal or intrinsic competence.
Native stochastic_failure is the inherited event.failed flag and need not denote a random physical error.
No new model calls, engine modifications, case-specific prompt tuning, status changes or git commit.
